title: Claude usage by work item
description: Claude usage joined to log-work work items on session.id (log_work.session.info). Cost, tokens, lines and Claude time come from the log-work transcript hook (log_work.usage.*, all session types; updates when a session's process stops). Your active time and commits come from Claude Code's native OTel export (terminal sessions only). Cost is Claude Code's own list-price estimate.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.cost_usd"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1)))

sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="claude_code.active_time.total", type="user", job=~"claude-code|claude-code-desktop"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1))) / 3600

(sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.api_seconds"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1))) + sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.tool_seconds"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1)))) / 3600

sum(count by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.cost_usd"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1)))

sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.lines", type="added"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1)))

sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="claude_code.commit.count", job=~"claude-code|claude-code-desktop"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1)))

panels.title: Unassigned cost (no work item)

targets.expr: sum(sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.cost_usd"}[$__range])) unless on("session.id") last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info"}[90d]))

panels.description: Sessions with usage but no log_work.session.info tag (log-work not tracking, or tag failed).

panels.title: Cost per day by work item

targets.expr: sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (increase({"__name__"="log_work.usage.cost_usd"}[$__interval])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1))

panels.title: Claude hours per day by work item

targets.expr: (sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (increase({"__name__"="log_work.usage.api_seconds"}[$__interval])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1)) + sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (increase({"__name__"="log_work.usage.tool_seconds"}[$__interval])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1))) / 3600

sum by (model) (sum by ("session.id", model) (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.cost_usd"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1))

sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.api_seconds"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1))) / 3600

sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.tokens", type="cacheRead"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1))) / sum(sum by (work_item) (sum by ("session.id") (max_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.usage.tokens", type=~"input|cacheRead|cacheCreation"}[$__range])) * on("session.id") group_left(work_item, work_title) (0 * topk by ("session.id") (1, last_over_time({"__name__"="log_work.session.info", work_item=~"${work_item:regex}"}[90d])) + 1)))
